source_text: Among men who have sex with men (MSM), efficacy is context-dependent and limited; meta-analyses show protection primarily for insertive partners in low- and middle-income countries (relative risk 0.58), but no benefit in high-income settings or for receptive anal intercourse, where exposure occurs via the ungloved penis.
